admission.justification: The retained PRF-XK9Z5B guards successful own-copy staging beside an unreadable neighbor by checking the warning and updated rendered copy. No typed proof is claimed here for post-publication rollback or the no-own-refresh failure: the explicit-directory case refuses during target preflight and preserves initial bytes. The production selection/finish branches keep the conditional tolerance and named fail-closed boundary, preventing an unrelated unreadable contract from blocking publication or tolerance without staged own copies.

applicability: Task-document refresh when an enclosure-position file is unreadable or carries no artifact cell and cannot be parsed.
conditions: An own enclosure counts for tolerance only when copy writes have been staged from it.
The subsequent atomic copy publisher still governs successful publication and rollback.
exclusions: A readable matching own contract whose parse fails remains a direct failure.
No roster is added to identify every damaged own enclosure.
This rule does not change other consumers’ parse-failure policies.
statement: An unreadable contract beside a refreshed own one is skipped and named while the write succeeds; with no own contract refreshed the refresh fails and names the file.
